description: This file defines the PomodoroProvider class, which manages timer flow, session durations, streak tracking, and persistence for a Pomodoro-style productivity app. It handles start, pause, reset, and session completion logic, as well as persisting session data and coordinating with other components like BoardProvider and DbService.

classes.name: PomodoroProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing the state and behavior of a Pomodoro timer, including timing, session types, streaks, and persistence.

methods.name: setTaskName
methods.description: Sets the current task name and notifies listeners.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts or resumes the timer, initializing periodic countdown.

methods.name: stopAndReset
methods.description: Stops the timer and resets session state; resets board and streaks if interrupted during focus.

methods.name: _onTick
methods.description: Handles each tick of the timer, decrementing _remaining and completing session if timer ends.

methods.name: _completeCurrent
methods.description: Handles actions upon session completion, including persisting session data, updating streaks, and scheduling breaks.

methods.name: _durationForType
methods.description: Returns the Duration corresponding to a given SessionType.

methods.name: _saveInSessionFlag
methods.description: Persists whether the app is in an active focus session.

methods.name: handleAppBackgrounded
methods.description: Handles app going to background; resets focus session if running during focus when app backgrounded.
